def gen_near(v, w=0.06):
    q = torch.linspace(v-w, v+w, 2001, dtype=torch.float32).to(torch.float16)
    q = torch.unique(q)
    return q[(q > 0)]

xs = torch.cat([gen_near(0.66), gen_near(2.414213562373095)]).to("cuda")
o = k.run(xs)

j = int(e.argmax())

res = {"probe": "branch boundaries 0.66 and 2.414",
